title: The 5 biggest mistakes beginner programmers make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The biggest mistake is relying on vague prompts — "the" is too ambiguous for AI to deliver precise code. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "5" mistakes are concrete — they help beginners focus on specific errors, not abstract concepts like "the." (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: "The" allows for context-rich prompts, like "the Python function for sorting a list," which yields accurate, reusable code. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Focusing on "5" mistakes helps beginners avoid overwhelm — listing them makes learning manageable and goal-oriented. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Clarity beats ambiguity — "5" mistakes are actionable, while "the" mistake is just a vague excuse. (4 sec)
